The '''Fobosi District Medcenter''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] located in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]].<ref name="HNN 54" /> [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] stayed there after he was involved in a [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] crash in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="HNN 49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_3.html|Senator Dod in Five-Speeder Skylane Accident}}</ref>
